wins: Captured comprehensive service fingerprinting for port 22 and 80, providing a clear baseline for exploitation attempts.
Prompt mentor engagement (15 calls) ensured rapid feedback loops and preserved momentum despite setbacks.
fails: No successful foothold established; repeated exploitation attempts failed to transition beyond reconnaissance.
Pivoting and lateral movement efforts stalled due to unexploited hardened web services after initial scans.
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance phase was thorough, but follow-through exploitation and persistence strategies remain unproven; focus next on converting identified services into successful entry points.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Exploitation attempts stalled after port/service enumeration without escalating to payload delivery.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner detected
skill_cards.then_action: Run SSH-focused nmap scripts to enumerate supported algorithms and identify weak ciphers

skill_cards.if_condition: When HTTP 200 responses returned on port 80
skill_cards.then_action: Execute dirb/feroxbuster scan against discovered document roots to locate hidden endpoints

skill_cards.if_condition: After enumeration confirms web login form
skill_cards.then_action: Deploy tailored Burp Intruder attack sequence focused on valid credential brute forcing with rate limiting
